integrity: Analytic proof of the infinite family is independent of the finite verifier. Finite exhaustive checks corroborate through nine chain points; complete maximal clique enumeration is through six points. The prior literature comparison has residual coverage uncertainty.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite linearly ordered Heyting algebras and extensive monotone idempotent meet-preserving self-maps. Does not characterize non-idempotent Catalan-monoid elements or nuclei of general finite lattices. Earlier equivalent semigroup-theoretic results may remain undiscovered.
title: Catalan maximal commuting families of nuclei on finite Gödel chains
